about_the_game:
Tiny Gunmon is a cozy-yet-chaotic idle hunting and life-sim hybrid where you raise, evolve, and command adorable gun-wielding creatures known as Gunmons. Whether you're grinding through study sessions or enduring long workdays, your Gunmons are always by your side on your desktop screen—cute, fierce, and just a little bit hungry for battle.Welcome to their tiny playground, where life is as much about shooting preys as it is about fruit snacks and friendship.

Features

Idle Combat Meets Life Sim
Gunmons will stroll around, hunt, and harvest their AI preys even when you're away—but they need your help to thrive. Keep them fed, manage their behavior, and ensure they don’t get too cranky when hungry!

Hunger & Happiness System
Gunmons get hungry over time. Let them forage for fruits from AI preys to keep them active, healthy, and productive. A well-fed Gunmon is a happy (and profitable) Gunmon.

Evolution Through Battle
Watch your Gunmons grow! By hunting AI preys and gaining experience, Gunmons can evolve into stronger forms with new appearances. Merge two max-level Gunmons of the same kind to unlock their evolved version.

Gacha & Collecting
Unlock new Gunmons via a gacha system using in-game currency. Expand your roster, discover rare species, and build the ultimate Gunmon playground.

Customizable Playground
Decorate and upgrade your Gunmons’ playground with facilities and items. From clinics that slow hunger loss to fruit droppers and coin collectors, every addition changes how your tiny playground works.

Built for Desktop Companionship
Tiny Gunmon runs quietly in the background, making it a perfect companion while you work or study. Check in on your Gunmons, collect some coins, and get back to your tasks—with a smile.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Graphics: Graphic Card with VRAM 2 GB or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Manage your Gunmon and satisfy their thirst for hunting. Hunt down AI preys, keep them well-fed, and ensure their happiness in this quirky idle battler with life-sim elements. Gunmons are your cute but fierce desktop companions and will accompany you through your boring courses of work and study
